summary.content:
Today's selection covers 74 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 50 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Family of child injured in Canada school shooting sues OpenAI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: New KadNap botnet hijacks ASUS routers to fuel cybercrime proxy network
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 61 articles published in the last 24 hours
